port.description: Name of the service port this endpoint refers to. Mutually exclusive with targetPort.

targetPort.description: Name or number of the target port of the endpoint. Mutually exclusive with port.

path.description: HTTP path to scrape for metrics.

scheme.description: HTTP scheme to use for scraping.

interval.description: Interval at which metrics should be scraped

scrapeTimeout.description: Timeout after which the scrape is ended

tlsConfig.description: TLS configuration to use when scraping the endpoint

bearerTokenFile.description: File to read bearer token for scraping targets.

honorLabels.description: HonorLabels chooses the metric's labels on collisions with target labels.

basicAuth.description: BasicAuth allow an endpoint to authenticate over basic authentication More info: https://prometheus.io/docs/operating/configuration/#endpoints

metricRelabelings.description: MetricRelabelConfigs to apply to samples before ingestion.

title:
Endpoint defines a scrapeable endpoint serving Prometheus metrics.
See documentation https://coreos.com/operators/prometheus/docs/latest/api.html#endpoint
name: K8sEndpoint
